start.title: Iron Gate
start.text:
The gate slams shut behind you.
Falsely accused. Stripped of all favor.

choices.feedback: Bitterness will rot you here.
Genesis 39:21 — The Lord was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love.
Walls are thick. Guards are many.

curse_consequence.title: Hollow Words
curse_consequence.text:
Anger only echoes off the stone.
Hate cannot free you.

choices.feedback: You let the bitterness fall.

escape_consequence.title: No Way Out
escape_consequence.text:
Every corner is watched.
You sit back down on the cold floor.

choices.feedback: Trust where you cannot run.

first_night.title: First Night
first_night.text:
Lamplight flickers low.
You kneel and whisper His name.

choices.feedback: Genesis 39:21 — The Lord was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love.

choices.text: Curse the day you were born
choices.feedback: Despair feeds nothing.

despair_consequence.title: Dawn Returns
despair_consequence.text:
Even in darkness, morning comes.
You choose to rise again.

choices.feedback: You stand. A new day waits.

morning_work.title: A Task to Do
morning_work.text:
The keeper points to the buckets.
Water. Floors. Bread to carry.

choices.feedback: Pride will earn you the lash.

choices.text: Work as if for the Lord
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:22 — The keeper of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners.
He will see. He always sees.

refuse_consequence.title: A Hard Lesson
refuse_consequence.text:
The keeper's eyes narrow.
You take the bucket in silence.

choices.text: Work as if for the Lord
choices.feedback: Better to serve than to suffer pride.

lazy_consequence.title: Caught
lazy_consequence.text:
The keeper finds you idle.
His voice is sharp and short.

choices.feedback: You bow your head and lift the load.

faithful_work.title: The Lord Is With Joseph
faithful_work.text:
Whatever you touch, prospers.
The keeper begins to watch.

choices.text: Quietly thank God in your heart
choices.feedback: Genesis 39:23 — The Lord was with Joseph, and whatever he did, the Lord made it succeed.
Boasting ruins what humility built.

boast_consequence.title: Cold Looks
boast_consequence.text:
Other prisoners turn away.
Your words have cost you trust.

choices.feedback: You bow. The Lord lifts the lowly.

trusted_steward.title: Keys in His Hand
trusted_steward.text:
The keeper hands you the ring.
"All the prisoners — your charge."

choices.feedback: He laughs. You are still a prisoner.
Genesis 39:22 — The keeper of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners.

demand_consequence.title: Still a Prisoner
demand_consequence.text:
His face hardens.
The keys remain — but only just.

choices.feedback: You take the keys in silence.

two_arrivals.title: Pharaoh's Servants
two_arrivals.text:
Two new prisoners arrive.
Cupbearer and chief baker. Pale, afraid.

choices.feedback: A shepherd does not turn away.
Genesis 40:4 — The captain of the guard assigned Joseph to them, and he attended them.
Cruelty is not in the Lord's house.

ignore_consequence.title: A Soft Voice
ignore_consequence.text:
Their faces stay heavy.
You cannot turn from them.

choices.feedback: You kneel beside them.

mock_consequence.title: Their Eyes
mock_consequence.text:
They look up, hurt.
Shame settles in your chest.

choices.feedback: You ask their forgiveness.

morning_sad.title: Why So Downcast?
morning_sad.text:
At dawn their faces are dark.
Something troubles them deeply.

choices.feedback: Genesis 40:8 — Joseph asked them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me."

choices.text: Stay silent — none of your concern
choices.feedback: Silence helps no one here.
God's gift is not for sale.

silent_consequence.title: Their Burden
silent_consequence.text:
They sit in silence.
You cannot leave them this way.

choices.feedback: Their eyes lift toward you.

greedy_consequence.title: A Gift, Not Goods
greedy_consequence.text:
Their faces fall further.
This is not how the Lord gives.

choices.text: Ask freely — it is God's gift
choices.feedback: You smile. "Speak. Tell me."

interpret_offer.title: To God Belong Answers
interpret_offer.text:
"Do not interpretations belong to God?
Tell me your dreams."

choices.feedback: The cupbearer leans forward to speak.

cupbearer_dream.title: The Vine
cupbearer_dream.text:
"A vine — three branches budding.
I pressed grapes into Pharaoh's cup."

choices.feedback: The Lord does not speak through flattery.
Genesis 40:8 — Joseph said, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me."

flatter_consequence.title: Truth Only
flatter_consequence.text:
Lies will not honor God.
You must speak what is true.

choices.feedback: You bow your head and begin.

cupbearer_meaning.title: Three Days
cupbearer_meaning.text:
"Three branches: three days.
Pharaoh will lift up your head."

choices.feedback: Genesis 40:14 — Joseph asked the cupbearer to remember him and mention him to Pharaoh.
God's gift was never for sale.

demand_wages_consequence.title: Open Hands
demand_wages_consequence.text:
His face goes cold.
You must serve, not bargain.

choices.text: Only ask him to remember you
choices.feedback: "Only remember me," you whisper.

remember_request.title: Remember Me
remember_request.text:
"When all is well — remember me.
I was stolen from my land."

choices.feedback: The baker steps forward, hopeful.

baker_dream.title: Three Baskets
baker_dream.text:
"Three baskets on my head — birds
ate the bread meant for Pharaoh."

choices.feedback: A lie helps no one in the end.
Genesis 40:19 — Joseph told the chief baker that Pharaoh would lift off his head and hang him on a tree.
Refusing will not change the dream.

lie_consequence.title: He Deserves Truth
lie_consequence.text:
A kind lie still leaves him blind.
He must hear what is real.

choices.feedback: You meet his eyes with sorrow.

refuse_interp_consequence.title: He Waits
refuse_interp_consequence.text:
His pleading eyes hold yours.
God has given. You must speak.

choices.feedback: You begin softly, with care.

baker_meaning.title: Hard Words
baker_meaning.text:
"Three baskets: three days.
Pharaoh will lift you on a tree."

choices.feedback: You sit with him until the lamp dims.

third_day.title: The Third Day
third_day.text:
Pharaoh's birthday dawns.
Guards come for both men.

choices.feedback: Genesis 40:20 — On Pharaoh's birthday, he restored the chief cupbearer and hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had interpreted.
Anger will only earn you chains.

rage_consequence.title: Be Still
rage_consequence.text:
A spear lowers toward your chest.
You fall back, breathing hard.

choices.feedback: You whisper a prayer instead.

wait_news.title: Word Returns
wait_news.text:
It is as you said.
The cupbearer lives. The baker does not.

choices.feedback: Genesis 40:23 — The chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
Bitterness blinds the watchful eye.

curse2_consequence.title: Let It Go
curse2_consequence.text:
Hate cannot reach Pharaoh's hall.
Only God can.

choices.feedback: You release the bitter knot inside.

forgotten.title: Forgotten
forgotten.text:
Days. Months. Two long years.
The cupbearer remembers him not.

choices.feedback: Despair will steal the morning.
Genesis 40:23 — The chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him for two full years.
The guard takes nothing. You lose more.

despair2_consequence.title: A Soft Light
despair2_consequence.text:
Through the window, a single ray.
God is still near.

choices.feedback: You rise. Hope is not gone.

bribe_consequence.title: Empty Hands
bribe_consequence.text:
He laughs. Your bread is gone.
No one will buy your freedom.

choices.feedback: Only God can open this gate.

still_trust.title: The Lord Is With You
still_trust.text:
Even forgotten by men,
you are not forgotten by Him.

choices.feedback: The keys jingle softly at your side.

ending.title: His Time Will Come
ending.text:
The lamp burns. The Lord watches.
Pharaoh's dream is yet to come.
